problem_and_intended_users_defined.rationale: The product defines the public maintainer/CI problem precisely: validate DAIS Universal Evidence structure and optional exact local artifact hashes without conflating validation with producer identity, authorization or semantic truth.

public_repository_or_distribution_surfac.rationale: P-050 is distributed as a reusable public GitHub composite Action and released at v0.3.0.

explicit_open_source_license.rationale: The public repository contains the MIT License covering the P-050 source.

complete_readme.rationale: The product-scoped engineering document is the complete README surface for the shared proving-ground repository: purpose, architecture, components, usage, runtime/supply-chain constraints, security/privacy, accessibility, recovery, interoperability, limitations and completion scope are explicit.

beginner_start_here_path.rationale: A dedicated beginner/operator path explains PASS/non-PASS semantics, minimal use, outputs, provenance separation, recovery, privacy and support.

engineering_or_architecture_documentatio.rationale: The validation boundary, path containment, resource bounds, input immutability, atomic reporting, runtime dependency model and attestation composition are documented and represented in source.

reproducible_installation_or_use_instruc.rationale: The released Action requires Linux x64/CPython 3.12, installs an exact hash-locked binary-wheel dependency graph, and the clean-runtime lane plus two released-ref consumer jobs proved use from fresh hosted environments.

safety_scope_and_limitations.rationale: The release explicitly limits PASS to schema conformance and optional exact local hash equality; producer authentication, authorization, semantic truth, artifact goodness, redaction and recursive bundle traversal are excluded.

recovery_or_rollback_guidance_for_mutati.rationale: P-050 does not mutate evidence or referenced artifacts. Recovery guidance requires interrupted/missing/partial/FAIL results to be discarded and validation rerun against unchanged inputs; atomic report publication prevents partial reports from being treated as complete results.

tests_and_ci.rationale: Adversarial unit/Action tests cover schema/hash validation, traversal, symlink escape, duplicate names, resource bounds and immutability. Canonical-main CI separately proved clean dependency installation, cryptographic attestation interoperability, exact release publication and two released-ref consumers.

security_and_privacy_review.rationale: The review covers non-execution of referenced artifacts, containment/traversal/symlink refusal, bounded hashing, no validator network access, input immutability, explicit sensitive-evidence non-redaction warning, privacy-safe support intake and separation of validation from signed provenance.

accessibility_review.rationale: The released interface is text/JSON/YAML/CLI-first with explicit textual PASS/FAIL, bounded counts, categorized plain-language annotations and machine-readable reports usable by assistive tooling. This is an applicability review for a non-graphical developer Action, not a WCAG-conformance or human assistive-technology claim.

multilingual_path_considered.rationale: Stable machine keys are intentionally language-neutral interoperability identifiers and human documentation can be localized independently. The v0.3.0 documentation is English-first and multilingual user acceptance is not claimed.

contribution_and_issue_paths.rationale: General contribution guidance plus a dedicated privacy-safe P-050 issue path exist.
